## Line 82

```plato

    // How many times the shell cites an edge in its reversed direction.
    ReversedUseCount(b: Brep3D, e: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Integer
        => b.AllEdgeUses.Reduce(0, (acc, u) =>
            acc + ((u.Edge.Value == e.Value && u.IsForward.Not) ? 1 : 0));
```
